title: Ines and the Garden
author: Odile Okonkwo
blurb: Dominic Underhill, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
